idea-plugin.name: Local Secrets Tripwire
idea-plugin.description:
Local Secrets Tripwire

Scans files for accidentally committed secrets (API keys, passwords, tokens, private keys) using pattern matching and Shannon entropy analysis. Highlights findings in the editor with gutter warnings and file-level annotations.

Features

  • Pattern matching — detects AWS keys, GitHub tokens, private keys, JWTs, and more
  • Entropy analysis — identifies high-entropy strings that may be secrets
  • Editor integration — gutter icons and inline warnings for detected secrets
  • Allowlist — suppress false positives via .secrets-allowlist
  • Configurable — adjust patterns, entropy threshold, and scanning behavior

Part of DevOps Safety Kit

Pairs with Kubernetes Context Guard and Terminal Safety Rails for comprehensive protection against accidental production changes and secret leaks.
